title: Choose the look for the Tally on NEAR demo page
question: The roll picked Broadcast Decision. Keep it, take the alternate, or re-roll. All of them keep near-black, pink #FF248B and clean type.

options.label: Broadcast Decision
options.thesis: Every card gets a review, and the verdict lands like a referee's decision on screen.
options.viewport: Tabs on top; a drop zone on the left; on the right a decision panel that reads CHECKING, then cuts to a full-width verdict bar with the date and the explorer link.
options.risk: Reads as sports theatre if the verdict bar is oversized or animated for too long.

raised.raise: The fingerprint is set as dense mono data and drawn as a 64-bar code, so the hash is visible, not hidden.
Pink appears only on what you can press and on the verdict itself; nothing decorative is pink.
One body size does the work; hierarchy comes from weight and the verdict bar, not a ladder of sizes.
History rows keep dates right-aligned tight in tabular figures, so corrections read as a timeline.
The layout reflows by whole columns, never by shrinking type.
Entry importance is carried by one size ramp: the latest verdict large, earlier entries small.

options.label: Evidence Label
options.lineage: forensic evidence bags and chain-of-custody logs
options.thesis: The card is an exhibit: the fingerprint is its exhibit number, the history is its custody log.
options.viewport: Tabs on top; a drop zone left; on the right an exhibit label with the fingerprint as its number and a custody log of every entry.
options.risk: Familiar: 'forensic' is where most anti-fraud pages land, and it can feel like a crime-show costume.

options.label: Data Field
options.thesis: The fingerprint as a strobing black-and-white data field.
options.viewport: A full-width bar field with the verdict as one inverted frame.
options.case: Loses both axes: no colour conflicts with the pinned pink, and strobing hides the verdict.
options.risk: Unreadable for a trader who just wants the answer.
options.kept: The fingerprint drawn as dense mono data and a bar code.

options.label: Acetate Manual
options.thesis: Each tab a coloured divider board under acetate leaves.
options.viewport: A manual open at a tabbed section.
options.case: Loses both axes: a light, multi-hue manual fights the pinned near-black.
options.risk: A costume of print documentation on a working tool.
options.kept: One body size does the work.

options.label: Warm Consumer App
options.thesis: Soft cards on a warm ground, one action colour.
options.viewport: Stacked cards with a thumb bar.
options.case: Loses both axes: a warm light ground breaks the pinned look.
options.kept: The accent appears only where something can be done.

options.label: Mixtape J-Card
options.case: Loses both axes: handwriting undercuts a proof registry's authority.
options.kept: Dates right-aligned tight, like running times.

options.label: Grid Specimen
options.thesis: Verdicts built cell by cell on a visible grid.
options.viewport: A giant grid-built FAKE over graph lines.
options.case: Loses both axes: a poster first, a tool second.

options.label: Star Atlas
options.thesis: Cards as stars, magnitude as checks.
options.case: Loses both axes: a single lookup has no sky to map.
options.kept: Hierarchy carried by one size ramp.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: A clean dark verification tool: upload box, result card, history table.
canonCard.viewport: Centered upload box, a result card under it with a badge and a table.
canonCard.risk: Indistinguishable from every other checker by design.
